C0847.title: SK Telecom Users Targeted by AI Voice Phishing After Data Breach, Scammers Impersonate Customer Service with Leaked Information
C0847.summary: In 2025, following a major data breach at South Korean telecom giant SK Telecom, thousands of users fell victim to customer-service impersonation vishing attacks. Fraudsters exploited the leaked personal data to precisely mimic official scripts and trick users into disclosing verification codes.
